records.subject: Thermodynamically guided design of p- and n-type ionic thermoelectric polymer complexes
records.object: Tailoring ion–polymer matrix interplay through controlled synthesis
records.quote: Here, a thermodynamically guided design strategy is reported for high-performance p- and n-type ionic TE polymer complexes.
